steps.text: CAM BUG-65e/73e: no per-frame allocation from DeskView, CameraFeel or CityView over two cycles of the reading view turned in and back and the city looked at and back on day 12. camcycle n = 1 starts the cycle in the background: it waits for the gc window to open, turns one frame later, holds each move for its seconds and a settle in frames at the 30 fps game step (300 frames at the code's knobs, inside the window's 360) and allocates nothing itself. Both views' clocks take that step (the reading blend's game time; the city's turn, fade and parallax on UiMotion.Delta, a capture's fixed step; until round 9 the city ran on unscaled time, which a capture does not reach, so above 45 Hz its look was cut short), so the cycle is the same frames and the same motion at any display rate. camcycle n = 0 reports cycle.cam_cycle: every turn taken, every city move landed on its own clock with its settle to spare, the window open before the first and still open after the cycle's last frame (gate cam.bp.gc with the gc line; cam.play.cycle in the editor). gc_sites.tsv names the call sites. The 0 B gate is [BP]: run it with run_player.py on the QA player; in the editor the number includes the editor's own allocations.
